elements.name: text-1
elements.text: Corrections targeted known scoring and segmentation differences

Experiment	Change	Result
Historical lexical compatibility	Dictionary, POS/category rules
and fixed pause handling	Strong LUCID agreement
in babble and L2
Native CHAT scoring	Faithful export with official
CLAN MLU and FREQ	Vocabulary errors mostly
below 3% on existing tests
Input-mode comparison	Paragraph ML, observed-turn ML
and observed-turn rules	Eval selected observed-turn ML
Bounded margin calibration	Seven fixed margins in
two input modes	Eval selected margin 0.25
Count / MLU gains were modest
